decisions.reason: As a recently launched extension of the firm’s established marking portfolio, this workstation still faces unresolved market uncertainty and is inexpensive enough strategically to keep on offer while the firm learns from customer uptake in longer industrial sales cycles.

This thermal inkjet printer is close to the core business, visibly supported on its own product page, and fits the firm’s growth, R&D and Industry 4.0 direction, so the option value of staying in the market remains high.

This piezo inkjet printer is also closely aligned with the firm’s existing capabilities and customer applications, and after only one year there is too little evidence to abandon an option that could strengthen its customized coding solutions.
